content: Official Next.js static export documentation (updated 2026-08-09) confirms `output: 'export'` emits an HTML file per route, supports client components and client-side interactions, but browser APIs must be accessed safely after hydration (for example in effects) because client components are prerendered. Server-dependent features such as request-based handlers, headers/cookies, server actions, and default image optimization are unsupported. Project config already uses static export, trailingSlash, basePath and unoptimized images, so polish should retain those constraints.
